title: After the Yomiuri Milers C.: Inspiring Courage

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: My new running style is slowly starting to stabilize. I think I'll be able to do some amazing running someday.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But I'm concerned about Zephyr. She seems really preoccupied over something. I gather up the courage to ask her what's wrong, and she tells me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: There's someone Zephyr looks up to, and she's doing her best for that person's sake… but she's hit a wall she can't seem to overcome.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I understand what it feels like to want to do your best for someone else. I want to do well at the Yasuda Kinen and give her the courage to run her best too!
